MATT JOHNSON Head of Commercial Strategy

X Matt Johnson Head of Commercial Strategy Matt Johnson is Head of Commercial Strategy for Raymond James Investment Management.  He joined Raymond James Investment Management in 2020, previously Head of Product Strategy and Development and Marketing responsible for product strategy, new product development and marketing. Johnson also held roles at Raymond James Financial since 2015, including Vice President of Strategy and Product Development for the Asset Management Group and Assistant to the Chairman. Before joining Raymond James, he worked in management consulting for the financial services industry. He has a Bachelor of Business Administration from Stetson University and an M.B.A. from New York University.
